title: Date page order: day links on top, picker below the reading

history.detail:
PASS: PASS, gate 1, audit of 680d041.

Sprint file: read fresh. Its amendments (8db70fd, ac5ce6b at 14:30) all predate start (4a061b7 at 14:50), and nothing has touched it since. The build follows the amended version: day links above the date band, R10, and R11.

Handoff: read at the audited commit. It has a Round 1 section quoting VERIFY PASS (lint, typecheck, test, build) exit=0, with 604 tests.

Diff 4a061b7..680d041. My own check: npm run verify at 680d041, on a clean primary checkout. Result: verify=0, VERIFY PASS exit=0, 54 test files and 604 tests passed.

- R1 Met. ReadingView's belowDateBand became aboveDateBand. It renders in the same flowSlot wrapper right after SiteBanner, before the date band. The date page passes only DateNavigation. Nothing renders between the date band and the body.
  The .dateNav adjustments are exactly the three properties that separated it from the now-gone picker row (margin-top, padding-top, border-top). They are named in the handoff. The .adjacent link styles are untouched.
- R2 and R4 Met. DatePicker is the one panel, rendered once at the start of afterBody, with no desktopOnly or mobileOnly. RandomReading.tsx and .randomSection are deleted.
  A grep finds DatePicker rendered only at page.tsx:129, and loadRandomReadingDate called only at page.tsx:99. There is no RandomReading, randomSection or belowDateBand left in app or lib.
  The form's GET to /date, min, max = today and required are unchanged. The link's markup moved inline unchanged. The "or" and link still render together, only when there's a date.
- R3 Met. On desktop, the picker, label, input, button, link and "or" rules are unchanged. .anotherDate reuses flowSlot's padding and rule.
  The phone-only additions are layout, for R3's stated limits, not new visual treatment:
  - display contents on pickerControls, so label, input and Go share a row and the or-plus-link span wraps;
  - min-height 44px on the input and button;
  - border-box and inline-flex centring on the link, so it measures like the button.
  I opened phone-390-bottom.png: label, input and Go on one row, then "or Discover random reading" below, inside the panel. The handoff reports 44px controls and scrollWidth 390.
- R5 Met. The DOM order is banner, day links, date band, body, Another date, then the phone and desktop Notable dates copies. The CSS grep for order, column-reverse or row-reverse exits 1. Tab order is reported in the same order.
- R6 Met. The only /reading test edits are R10's two quoted strings in accuracy-pages.test.ts, plus the phone-order expectation in events-placement-pages.test.ts. That one renders the date page's afterBody, so it is not a /reading assertion. /reading/[id]'s page code is untouched.
- R7 Met. The new page-order.test.ts checks the landmark order, that nothing sits between the date band and the body, the day links alone in the strip, exactly one date input, and at most one random link. Sprint 47's two-copy test is retired and replaced, and the updated tests are listed in the handoff.
- R8 Met. The README now describes the top-to-bottom order.
- R9 Met. I opened desktop-1280-top, desktop-1280-bottom, phone-390-bottom and phone-390-today-top. They show the day links under the banner (with today's disabled Next day and message on the phone shot), the date band directly above the chart, the panel after the body, then Notable dates.
- R10 Met. The two strings in lib/date-page/accuracy.ts are exactly as specified. The grep for "date above" exits 1.
- R11 Met. HEADING is "Notable dates", one constant for both copies. The grep for "Other notable dates" exits 1.

Note for Master Controller: an UNOWNED item I routed in sprint 48, the picker wording on /reading/[id], is now smaller but still there. That page has no picker, and its message now reads "Pick a different date." without "above". It is still an instruction with no control on that page. Not this sprint's scope (R6), and not part of this verdict.

For Pipeman: sprint 53 (Dev Team 2, devteam2/sprint-53) also edits reading.module.css and date.module.css, in different rules from this sprint (the max-width lines versus flowSlot comments, dateNav and the new picker rules). Expect at most a small textual merge.

No issues found. Still UNOWNED, with Master Controller: the 3 lint warnings in the sprint 45 and 46 probe scripts.

PASS: PASS, gate 1 round 2, audit of 2023e53: sprint 52 re-verified on the combined tree after sprint 53's merge.

Why a re-audit: sprint 53 (ec772da) was merged into main after my round 1 PASS of 680d041. The shippable tree changed, so the round 1 tree hash can't match it.

Sprint file: re-read fresh. Unchanged since start.

Handoff: read at the audited commit. A Round 2 section was added; Round 1 is untouched (no deleted lines in the handoff diff). It quotes VERIFY PASS (lint, typecheck, test, build) exit=0, with 611 tests.

What changed since 680d041 in app and lib: git diff 680d041 2023e53 is content-identical to sprint 53's own audited diff (88ae25a..c3c054e). Comparing the two diffs differs only in blob index hashes and hunk line offsets. Those changes are reading.module.css (the max-width removals and one comment), one line in date.module.css, and reading-text-width.test.ts. No app or lib change after the merge commit 9a3e4c0. Nothing of sprint 52 was lost or altered.

My own check: npm run verify at 2023e53, on a clean primary checkout. Result: verify=0, VERIFY PASS exit=0, 55 test files and 611 tests passed.

Sprint 52's requirements R1 to R11 stand as found in round 1. I opened round2/desktop-1280-bottom.png: the Another date panel follows the body, then Notable dates.

DEFECT FOUND IN THE COMBINED TREE, owned by sprint 53, not sprint 52. The idle-state sigil, the triangle-in-circle beside "The chart stands as it is…", is squeezed by the flex row since sprint 53 removed .idleText's max-width.
- .idleBlock is display flex, gap 22px. The svg has width and height attributes of 34 and no flex-shrink rule. .idleText can now grow to the full column, so the row shrinks the svg.
- Compare round 1's desktop-1280-bottom.png (680d041, before sprint 53) with round 2's (2023e53, same date and width). The text's left edge moves from about x 729 (673 + 34 + 22, the full sigil) to about x 710. The sigil is visibly reduced to a small glyph.
- Sprint 53's own after-idle-1945-05-08-1280.png shows the same small sigil.
This is recorded separately as a live-loop FAIL on sprint 53 (ec772da), where the fix belongs. It doesn't block this verdict, because no sprint 52 requirement covers it and the same code is already live from sprint 53's ship. Shipping sprint 52's tree before sprint 53's fix lands changes nothing about that defect's exposure.

Still UNOWNED, with Master Controller: the /reading/[id] "Pick a different date." wording with no picker on that page, and the 3 lint warnings in the sprint 45 and 46 probe scripts.
commit=2023e53 | ci=green: 1 CI run(s) for 2023e53b3bcc16020c51177399b2a1fcdb856b2b all completed successfully with real steps executed.

PASS: PASS (round 1). LiveQA steps 1 to 7 all pass on production, at 1280 and 390. No defects of this sprint's own. The squeezed idle sigil visible in these pages is Sprint 53's defect, already recorded against Sprint 53 (CONDITIONAL); it is not counted here.

Tested 2026-11-25, about 20:36 to 20:45 UTC, against https://my-little-racoon.vercel.app.
Shipped commit 2023e53. Production serves the pushed tip 2363cc8: /api/health/db reports status ok, connected true, commit 2363cc8, with migrationVersion unchanged at 20261122152710_navigation_exact_date_readings. git diff 2023e53 origin/main touches only docs/sprints/state/sprint-52.json and sprint-53.json.
Tools: headless Chromium (Playwright 1.57) at 1280x900, and 390x900 (isMobile, hasTouch).

STEP 1, 1280 on /date/1969-07-20: PASS. DOM order and vertical order agree: banner (65-220), day nav (234-268, "← PREVIOUS DAY 19 July 1969 NEXT DAY → 21 July 1969"), date band (317-384, "THE SKY OVER 20 July 1969"), chart tabs (411), events (411-608) and reading (608-1181), the "Another date" panel (1181-1247), then the "Notable dates" heading (1260).
- Nothing renders between the date band and the body: the screenshot shows the band's rule, then the chart tabs directly.
- The panel is one row: "ANOTHER DATE", the input (x 224, 136x37), GO (370, 50x34), "or" (same row), and DISCOVER RANDOM READING (455, 215x34). It has padding 14px 40px and a 1px solid top rule.
- Exactly 1 date input and 1 random link on the page.
- The footer heading is "Notable dates", nav aria-labelledby notable-dates-panel-heading. "Other notable dates" appears nowhere in the page text.
- Screenshots: s52-1280_date_1969_07_20-top.png and -bottom.png.

STEP 2, 390 on /date/1969-07-20: PASS. Same order: banner 8-111, day nav 121-155, date band 180-239, chart tabs 256, events 600-768, reading 768-1037, panel 1037-1156, "Notable dates" heading 1175.
- Panel: "ANOTHER DATE", the input (136x44) and GO (50x44) on one row (y 1048). "or" and DISCOVER RANDOM READING (215x44) on the line below (y 1102), inside the same panel. Every control is 44px tall. Padding 10px 24px, with a 1px top rule.
- scrollWidth is 390.
- The phone notable section is labelled notable-dates-section-heading, with heading "Notable dates".
- Screenshots: s52-390-top-1969.png and s52-390-panel.png.

STEP 3, the picker from its new place: PASS. At both widths, filling 1912-04-15 and pressing Go lands on /date/1912-04-15 ("Retroactive Horoscope 1912-04-15"). Filling 2026-11-26 and pressing Go doesn't submit: the URL stays, and the browser message is "Value must be 11/25/2026 or earlier." The input has min 1700-01-01, max 2026-11-25, required true, name "date"; the form is GET to /date.

STEP 4, Discover random reading: PASS. Five loads of /date/1969-07-20:
- 1280: /date/1929-10-24, /date/2023-05-06, /date/1939-09-01, /date/2009-11-23, /date/1969-09-01 (5 distinct).
- 390: /date/2024-03-26, /date/2021-01-06, /date/1989-11-09, /date/1969-09-01, /date/2023-05-06 (5 distinct).
Never the current date. Clicking it (1280) and tapping it (390) landed on /date/1969-09-01 and /date/2023-05-06, both saved readings.

STEP 5, today's page /date/2026-11-25: PASS at both widths. The day nav under the banner reads "← PREVIOUS DAY 24 November 2026 NEXT DAY → Reloy predicts only the past.", and the aria-disabled "Next day" element is inside the day nav. Screenshot: s52-1280_date_2026_11_25-top.png.

STEP 6, Tab order from the top: PASS at both widths. The zones are reached in this order: BANNER ("Ask Reloy") > DAYNAV (Previous day, Next day) > CHART (tabs, chart) > EVENTS ("source") > READING ("REVEAL THE HOROSCOPE") > PANEL (date input, GO, DISCOVER RANDOM READING) > NOTABLE (15 April 1912 ... 11 March 2020).
On /date/1969-07-20 the events come before the reading (Sprint 48's matched order), so EVENTS precedes READING in DOM and Tab order alike.

STEP 7, unmatched /date/2026-11-25: PASS at both widths. "The reading" reads: "We have no recorded events for this exact date, so we can't write an accurate horoscope for it. Pick a different date, or choose one of the years listed under "What happened" to go to that date instead." No "date above" text in the page.
The order is reading (1280: 411-655), then events (655-1353), then the "Another date" panel (1353-1419), directly below the events, then "Notable dates" (1432). On phone: 600-829, 829-1639, panel 1639-1758, then 1777.

0 console or page errors.
